name: GenAI
title: GenAI Code Analysis
headline: LLM-Powered Code Property Graph (CPG) Queries
summary: A sophisticated source code analysis tool that combines static analysis with LLMs. Allows for semantic querying of codebases to find vulnerabilities and identify design patterns.

rationale.title: Graph Representation
rationale.description: Using Joern to parse code into Neo4j CPGs, enabling complex traversal of data flows.

rationale.title: Local Inference
rationale.description: Ollama serves the GenAI model locally, ensuring sensitive source code never leaves the development environment.

rationale.title: Semantic Search
rationale.description: Bridging the gap between structural graph queries and natural language intent.

videos.title: AI Prompting
videos.desc: Asking the LLM to find logic flaws in the graph.

videos.title: Joern Ingestion
videos.desc: Converting raw source code into a Property Graph.

mermaidDiagram:
graph TD
    Code[Source Code] -->|Joern| CPG[(Neo4j Graph)]
    CPG --> LLM[Ollama / GenAI]
    LLM --> User[Semantic Query Results]

name: Stream Processing
title: Real-time Browser Monitoring
headline: Streaming Web Performance Analytics
summary: A high-velocity stream processing pipeline to monitor browser performance metrics in real-time. Captures events from Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and aggregates them for immediate visual insights.

rationale.title: Event Streaming
rationale.description: Leveraging Chrome DevTools Protocol to capture granular RUM (Real User Monitoring) data.

rationale.title: Messaging Bus
rationale.description: Redpanda (Kafka-compatible) chosen for its low-latency performance and simplified C++ architecture.

rationale.title: Data Enrichment
rationale.description: Redis acts as a real-time, in-memory lookup to enrich data streams with sub-millisecond latency.

videos.title: Live Grafana Dashboard
videos.desc: Visualising Core Web Vitals as they happen.

videos.title: Spark Windowing
videos.desc: Deep dive into the temporal aggregation logic.

mermaidDiagram:
graph LR
    A[Browser / CDP] -->|Events| B[Redpanda]
    B -->|Stream| C[Spark Streaming]
    C -->|Aggregate| D[(Redis)]
    D --> E[Grafana Dashboard]

name: Data Lakehouse
title: Data Lakehouse for Football Analytics
headline: End-to-End Sports Analytics Lakehouse
summary: A scalable Medallion architecture to ingest, transform, and query complex football datasets. Leverages Iceberg for table management, and Spark and Trino for high-performance distributed queries.

rationale.title: Storage Layer
rationale.description: Apache Iceberg and Parquet provide a reliable lakehouse foundation for high-speed analytical queries.

rationale.title: Orchestration
rationale.description: Airflow DAGs manage complex ELT and maintenance workflows, ensuring data integrity across the entire data lifecycle.

rationale.title: Scalability
rationale.description: Decoupled storage (MinIO) from compute (Spark & Trino) to allow independent scaling of infrastructure.

videos.title: Medallion Pipeline
videos.desc: Walking through Bronze to Gold transformation logic.

videos.title: Trino Query Performance
videos.desc: Demonstrating sub-second latency on large-scale analytical joins.

mermaidDiagram:
graph LR
    subgraph "Data Sources (External)"
        US[Understat]
        FB[FBref]
        TM[Transfermarkt]
        PI[Premier Injuries]
    end

    subgraph "Data Lakehouse (Apache Iceberg / S3)"
        direction TB
        subgraph "Bronze Layer: Raw Landing"
            B1[(Immutable Raw JSON)]
        end

        subgraph "Silver Layer: Cleansed & Integrated"
            S1[Entity Resolution]
            S2[Data Contracts]
            S1 --> S2
            S2 --> S3[(Master-Mapped Tables)]
        end

        subgraph "Gold Layer: Analytical Star Schema"
            G1[Fact Match Events]
            G2[Dim Players - SCD Type 2]
            G3[Incremental Materialization]
        end
    end

    US & FB & TM & PI --> B1
    B1 --> S1
    S3 --> G1
    S3 --> G2
    G1 & G2 --> G3
    G3 --> Dash[Scouting Dashboards]

    style B1 fill:#f96,stroke:#333
    style S3 fill:#6cf,stroke:#333
    style G3 fill:#9f9,stroke:#333

name: MLOps
title: Match Forecasting MLOps
headline: Predictive Modeling & Experiment Tracking
summary: A professional MLOps platform for football forecasting that uses MLflow to track experiments, version models, and streamline the journey from training to production.

rationale.title: Experiment Tracking
rationale.description: MLflow integration ensures every hyperparameter tweak and dataset version is logged for auditability.

rationale.title: Environment Parity
rationale.description: Containerised Jupyter environments ensure consistent library versions across development and production.

rationale.title: Model Governance
rationale.description: MinIO and MLflow provide a robust governance framework by combining logical lifecycle tracking with immutable physical storage.

videos.title: MLflow Dashboard
videos.desc: Comparing model runs and loss curves.

mermaidDiagram:
graph TD
    subgraph Data_Layer [Data & Storage]
        A[DuckDB] -->|Point-in-Time Joins| B(Feature Store)
    end

    subgraph Modeling_Layer [Modeling & Tracking]
        B -->|Historical Match Data| C[Statsmodels / SciPy]
        C -->|Poisson GLM Fitting| D{MLflow}
        D -->|Coefficients & Metadata| E(Model Registry)
    end

    subgraph Inference_Layer [Inference & UI]
        E -->|Stored Parameters| F[Streamlit Dashboard]
        F -->|Monte Carlo Simulation| G(Match Outcome Probabilities)
    end

    subgraph Infrastructure [DevOps & DX]
        H[Docker Compose] --- Data_Layer
        H --- Modeling_Layer
        H --- Inference_Layer
        I[Multi-stage Docker Build] --> H
        J[Makefile] -->|One-command Setup| H
    end

name: CI/CD
title: Modern CI/CD Pipeline
headline: Automated Quality Assurance and Deployment
summary: A professional-grade CI/CD workflow for a GitHub repository. Automates the entire lifecycle from linting and testing to performance auditing and deployment.

rationale.title: Testing Strategy
rationale.description: Implemented Vitest for lightning-fast unit and component testing within the Vite ecosystem.

rationale.title: Developer Experience
rationale.description: Strict ESLint and Prettier configurations enforced at the pre-commit and CI stages.

rationale.title: Automated Audits
rationale.description: GitHub Actions trigger Lighthouse CI to prevent performance regressions in pull requests.

videos.title: Action Workflows
videos.desc: Tracing a build from commit to deployment.

videos.title: Lighthouse Reports
videos.desc: Analyzing automated performance and accessibility scores.

mermaidDiagram:
graph LR
    Commit[Code Commit] -->|Trigger| GHA[GitHub Actions]
    GHA --> Test[Vitest Unit Tests]
    GHA --> Audit[Lighthouse CI]
    Audit & Test --> Deploy[Vercel / S3 Deployment]
